question: Who among the following freedom fighters was accused of killing Michael o Dwyer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Udham Singh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 
 
Udham Singh, a prominent figure in the Indian independence movement, was accused of killing Sir Michael O'Dwyer, a former Lieutenant Governor of the Punjab province during British rule in India. The incident took place in the aftermath of the Jallianwala Bagh massacre, a tragic event where British troops under General Reginald Dyer opened fire on a peaceful gathering in Amritsar on April 13, 1919.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jallianwala Bagh Massacre: **
 
• The Jallianwala Bagh massacre was a turning point in India's struggle for independence, leading to widespread outrage and condemnation.
 
• General Dyer's brutal action resulted in the death of hundreds of innocent Indians and left a lasting impact on the collective psyche of the nation.
 
• **Udham Singh's Motivation: **
 
• Udham Singh was deeply affected by the Jallianwala Bagh massacre, witnessing the brutality firsthand as a teenager.
 
• He pledged to avenge the atrocity and sought justice for the victims, particularly holding responsible those in positions of authority.
 
• **Assassination of Michael O'Dwyer:** 
 
• On March 13, 1940, Udham Singh carried out the assassination of Sir Michael O'Dwyer in London during a meeting of the East India Association.
 
• O'Dwyer, who had endorsed Dyer's actions in the Jallianwala Bagh massacre, was seen by Singh as a symbol of British oppression in India.
 
• **Trial and Execution:** 
 
• Udham Singh was arrested immediately after the assassination and put on trial.
 
• During the trial, he declared that he had acted to avenge the victims of the Jallianwala Bagh massacre.
 
• Udham Singh was convicted of murder and subsequently executed on July 31, 1940. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Udham Singh's actions were seen by many as a courageous act of resistance against colonial oppression, and he became a symbol of the struggle for Indian independence.
 
• The British government's response to the Jallianwala Bagh massacre and the subsequent events contributed to the intensification of the independence movement in India.
 
• Udham Singh's legacy is remembered in India for his sacrifice and determination in seeking justice for the victims of the Jallianwala Bagh massacre.
 
• In summary, Udham Singh, motivated by the horrific events of the Jallianwala Bagh massacre, took the drastic step of assassinating Michael O'Dwyer as a form of retribution and justice for the victims. His actions reflect the deep impact of historical atrocities on individuals and the role of such events in shaping the course of the Indian independence movement.
